title: Internet service issue - Rothbury, NSW
current_summary:
One service in the Rothbury, NSW area is affected. The fault was logged at 7:58 am AEDT on 14 November 2026, and there is no restoration estimate yet.

A power outage near the local network equipment has drained its backup battery, so service is down. A generator is to be installed to supply power until mains power returns.

Remote troubleshooting indicates an unplanned local power outage is affecting the nbn network causing a loss of service to customers. The backup battery power at the site has been depleted. Field services will attend the site to deploy a generator as an alternate power source during the ongoing power outage. Further updates will be provided as more information, or an ETA, becomes available.

cause.reason: Local power outage affecting the network
cause.detailed: An unplanned local power outage is affecting the network and the backup battery at the site has been depleted. Field services will attend to deploy a generator as an alternate power source.
